title: FLARE: A Systematic, Uncertainty-Aware Framework for Evidence-Based Adoption of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare
abstract: arXiv:2608.23643v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly being introduced into healthcare workflows, yet most evaluations emphasize model accuracy rather than whether adoption is economically worthwhile in real clinical settings. This study proposes FLARE, a systematic and uncertainty-aware framework for evaluating the financial and operational implications of adopting AI in healthcare. FLARE combines fuzzy logic, time-driven activity-based costing, and return on investment analysis to estimate the cost of clinical service delivery, the cost of AI development and operation, and the economic consequences of workflow integration under uncertainty. The framework was demonstrated through an early health technology assessment case study of AI-assisted large vessel occlusion detection in the CT stroke pathway for acute ischemic stroke. translated_title: FLARE：一个系统性、不确定性感知的框架，用于医疗保健中基于证据的人工智能采用
translated_abstract: 人工智能正越来越多地被引入医疗工作流程，但大多数评估强调模型准确性，而非在真实临床环境中采用是否具有经济价值。本研究提出FLARE，一个系统性和不确定性感知的框架，用于评估在医疗保健中采用人工智能的财务和运营影响。FLARE结合模糊逻辑、时间驱动作业成本法和投资回报分析，以估算临床服务交付成本、人工智能开发和运营成本，以及不确定性下工作流程整合的经济后果。该框架通过急性缺血性卒中CT卒中路径中人工智能辅助大血管闭塞检测的早期健康技术评估案例研究进行了演示。案例研究展示了FLARE如何量化常规路径成本、人工智能相关开发及经常性成本，以及人工智能赋能带来的影响。
tldr: FLARE是一个结合模糊逻辑和成本分析的系统性框架，用于在不确定性下评估医疗AI采用的经济可行性，并通过卒中检测案例验证了其应用价值。
en_tdlr: FLARE is a systematic, uncertainty-aware framework combining fuzzy logic and cost analysis to evaluate the economic viability of AI adoption in healthcare, validated through a stroke detection case study.
